links.outcome: Presence of formal workplace AI policy reported by respondents
links.effect: No formal workplace AI policy reported by 54.4% of PTs and 60.6% of PTAs.
links.quote: More than half of respondents reported no formal workplace AI policy (PTs: 54.4%; PTAs: 60.6%), and the vast majority had received no training in AI prompt development (PTs: 81.8%; PTAs: 84.5%).

links.outcome: Receipt of AI training (prompt development) among respondents
links.effect: No training in AI prompt development: 81.8% of PTs and 84.5% of PTAs.
links.quote: More than half of respondents reported no formal workplace AI policy (PTs: 54.4%; PTAs: 60.6%), and the vast majority had received no training in AI prompt development (PTs: 81.8%; PTAs: 84.5%).

links.outcome: Entry of personally identifiable information into AI systems by users
links.effect: Over 97% of both groups had never entered personally identifiable information into AI systems.
links.quote: Nearly all users reported editing AI-generated content before professional use (PTs: 91.7%; PTAs: 96.0%), and over 97% of both groups had never entered personally identifiable information into AI systems.

links.outcome: Self-reported editing of AI-generated content before professional use
links.effect: 91.7% of PT users and 96.0% of PTA users reported editing AI-generated content before professional use.
links.quote: Nearly all users reported editing AI-generated content before professional use (PTs: 91.7%; PTAs: 96.0%), and over 97% of both groups had never entered personally identifiable information into AI systems.

screen.reason: Cross-sectional survey of physical therapy professionals examining real-world generative AI adoption, oversight habits (e.g. human review/editing), and institutional policies.
